concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-docs-reference-response-masterpass-card-node]] - 2026-09-16 unversioned Braintree Node.js website Masterpass Card response reference for a generic gateway-returned credit/debit product-ID table with repeated code mappings; the captured containing-object list is blank, the title does not establish current Masterpass availability or applicability of every listed product, and response data is not SDK implementation or payment-outcome proof
warnings: The Masterpass Card title and route coexist with a generic credit/debit product-ID table; do not infer current wallet availability or that every listed product occurs in a Masterpass Card response.
The two returned-within list items are blank, so the snapshot does not identify containing response objects or provide a complete property schema.

The table is not one-code-to-one-product: `I` maps to Visa Infinite and Visa Infinite Privilege at lines 66-67, while `MHD` maps to MasterCard HELOC Debit Standard, Gold, Platninum and Premium at lines 129 and 132-134; the snapshot does not resolve which row applies.
